name: Bosideng Bridge
facts: When it opened, the Bosideng Bridge became the world’s third‑longest arch bridge, boasting a 530‑meter span that stretched across the Yangtze River in Sichuan.
Engineered as a concrete‑filled steel tubular (CFST) arch, the Bosideng Bridge set a new record for this design, eclipsing the earlier Wushan Yangtze Bridge.
The bridge is a vital artery on China’s G93 Chengdu–Chongqing Ring Expressway, channeling high‑volume traffic between the region’s major cities.
